tab.note: Existing desktop fa uses لبه (edge), which is a mistranslation; زبانه is the standard Persian UI term (Firefox convention).

view.note: The &View menu label is نمایش (existing); for the server-page sense (view limit) use نما.

popout window.note: No existing fa; a window split off from the main window.

notification area.note: Existing rendering, used in Windows settings wording.

minimize to tray.note: Existing rendering; literal کمینه کردن به سینی is not used.

Dock.note: macOS is not localized in Persian; keep the English platform term.

badge.note: No existing fa; the unread counter on the app icon (نشان خوانده‌نشده).

bounce.note: Verb: پریدن. The macOS Dock icon animation.

start app on login.note: Existing rendering appends به محیط‌کار (into the desktop session); Launch app minimized: بازکردن برنامه در پایین (existing) — بازکردن برنامه به‌صورت کمینه is clearer.

check for updates.note: Existing uses both بررسی به‌روزرسانی and بررسی خودکار برای به‌روزرسانی‌ها.

downloads.note: Existing rendering; بارگیری (not دانلود) is the desktop convention. Download Location: محل‌ذخیره بارگیری‌ها.

developer tools.note: No existing fa; standard Chromium/Firefox Persian term.

spell checker.note: Existing: Check spelling = بررسی املایی. As a noun feature name use بررسی املا or غلط‌یاب املایی.

certificate.note: Existing mixes گواهینامه and گواهی‌نامه; use the closed form گواهینامه.

authentication secret.note: No existing fa; the shared pre-authentication secret provided by an admin.

hardware acceleration.note: Existing string: استفاده از شتابدهنده گرافیک سخت‌افزاری.

dark mode.note: Existing uses سبک تیره once; حالت تیره is the standard Persian UI term (Android/Windows convention).

zoom.note: Zoom In: بزرگنمایی، Zoom Out: کوچک‌نمایی، Actual Size: اندازه واقعی (all existing).

clear data.note: Existing: Clear Cache and Reload = پاکسازی کش و بارگذاری مجدد; use پاک کردن داده‌ها for the data-reset actions.

logging level.note: Existing desktop fa renders logs as ردپا (Show logs = نمایش ردپاها); گزارش/لاگ would be more standard but keep ردپا for desktop consistency.
